name: Wand of Magic Missiles
description: Each charge spent increases the effective spell level by one (1 charge = 1st level, up to 7 charges for 7th level if you dump the whole thing at once) — the wand is the spellcasting focus, no material component needed. It regains 1d6+1 charges daily. There's also a small risk — if you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20; on a 1 the wand crumbles to ash and is destroyed. 1d4+1 force damage per dart, auto-hits.
